verdict.rationale: Cursor's core Agent (in editor, CLI, and Cloud Agents) is documented to take natural-language descriptions of features/bugs and implement multi-file changes: it can trace a repo, plan, edit across files, run tests, start dev servers, and open PRs, with artifacts to verify the fix. This is corroborated by extensive first-party docs on Agent, Cloud Agents, worktrees for parallel multi-file tasks, and CLI headless mode for scripted fixes. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks or third-party reviews specifically confirming multi-file bug-fix accuracy/quality (community evidence is mostly about general product sentiment, not this specific capability).
